moments.text: Upright phone video at night, the lower half blurred for privacy. A small blue-white light sits just right of centre in the dark sky.
The light slowly slides from right of centre to the left edge of the frame; a faint row of four points sits above it.
The camera brings the light back left of centre, then quick sideways jerks smear it into short streaks at 0:36.5-0:37.4.
The light drifts to the left edge again around 0:40, then is brought back toward the centre.
The camera zooms in: the light swells into a larger, soft blue-white glow, and the blurred lights below grow bigger.
Zoomed back out, the light is a small point again; it swings to the left side, then back to the centre.
A second zoom-in: the soft glow grows larger, sky fills most of the frame and the blurred ground below goes dark.
Zoomed out again: a small point in the upper centre, held fairly steady.
The camera zooms in once more and the light swells into a soft glow as the clip ends.

notes: Review tool's old auto-crop 608:508:0:572 (live has no crop; tool fixed) keeps only the privacy-blurred bottom half; the light is in the top half. No black bars: crop should be cleared or set to the top half.
